title: Morning Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Morning Sunwatch — November 10, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.5)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C2.8 (Peaked November 10, 2026 at 13:28 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 623 km/s (Fast)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.67)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

The solar wind is in a hurry today. 💨🌌👀

Several active regions and bright coronal loops are visible today, while the coronagraph shows no clearly identifiable large outward CME.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 193 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
